messages:
Asha (CSM): Morning team — kicking off Pelago onboarding. Goal: get prod API calls healthy and an internal demo by day 10. Quick 30m sync later today?

Leo (Solutions Eng): I can cover model mapping + initial route config. Need their rate expectations and sample prompts.

Ravi (Customer): Hi Asha/Leo — we expect ~1k req/day initially, spikes to ~5r/s during peak. I’ll drop sample prompts and a schema by EOD.

Maya (Enablement): I’ll schedule a 60m enablement session: 1) Console walkthrough 2) API keys + roles 3) Alerting runbook. Proposed: Wed 10am PT. Works?

Ravi (Customer): Wed 10am PT works for the Eng + PMs. Also we need SSO/SCIM setup docs.

Asha (CSM): Noted. Initial success criteria (day 10):
1) Prod API key issued & integration sending test traffic (>=5k tokens)
2) Latency <500ms p95 on sample load
3) First demo with PMs and sign-off on acceptance criteria
Owners: API integration = Ravi + Leo, Observability = Maya, Security & SSO = Asha.

Leo (Solutions Eng): For the p95 target we’ll enable intelligent batching + KV prefix caching. I’ll post recommended runtime config after today’s sync.

Asha (CSM): Here's the 10-day kickoff checklist to keep us honest:
```
Day 0: Kickoff + access provisioning (keys, console, SSO)
Day 1-3: API integration + smoke tests (5k token test)
Day 4-6: Observability + alerts (dashboard, PagerDuty, audit logs)
Day 7-9: Perf tuning + canary traffic + runbook dry-run
Day 10: Internal demo + success review + next-phase planning
```

Asha (CSM): Links: onboarding docs https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/pelago and project runbook https://console.redwood.ai/projects/pelago/onboard

Maya (Enablement): I created the calendar invite and attached slides + quickstart guide: https://drive.google.com/materials/pelago-onboard (invite shared with Ravi)

Leo (Solutions Eng): Quick question: should we provision Dedicated capacity for the initial ramp or stick to hosted with burst? Asha, any commercial constraints to note?

Asha (CSM): Customer is currently on trial credits. If they plan >10k req/day steady-state within 30d we’ll recommend Dedicated/reserved capacity. For now we can use hosted with autoscale and set throughput alerts.

Ravi (Customer): One risk to flag: our security policy requires forwarding audit logs to Splunk and retention 1y. Can you confirm integration?

Maya (Enablement): Yes, Splunk forwarder is supported. I’ll share the integration steps and sample config.

Asha (CSM): Logged risks: SSO/SCIM delay, Splunk audit integration, potential p95 regression on peak. Escalation path: tag #release-war-room for infra blockers.

onboard-bot: Reminder — please complete the pre-onboard survey: https://forms.redwood.ai/pelago (deadline: Wed 5pm PT)

Asha (CSM): Next steps: Leo to post initial runtime config by EOD, Ravi to send sample prompts + schema, Maya to confirm enablement invite and Splunk steps, I’ll create Asana milestones and follow up Friday.

Ravi (Customer): Thanks everyone — sending prompts and schema now.

Leo (Solutions Eng): Posting initial recommended config snippet:
```
model: rw-8b
batching: enabled
kv_cache: prefix
latency_target_ms: 500
monitoring: prom/p95, logs=audit
```

Asha (CSM): Perfect. I'll assign owners in Asana and set a follow-up for day 4 check-in. :thumbsup:
